_readme: Template for your own event. Copy it to local/ (gitignored) so your event details stay out of the repo, replace every value that starts with REPLACE, then run: make event FILE=local/your-event.json
_note: sponsorship_requirements below are in-kind (barter). Add a cash item such as "cash sponsorship" if you also want money; barter mode only applies when no requested type mentions cash. event_end_date is optional: leave it empty for a one-day event.
event_type: REPLACE: e.g. hackathon, coding challenge, tech fest
description: REPLACE: one or two lines about the event
benefits: brand visibility to participants (logo and mentions in event communication), a mention when prizes are announced, and direct reach to student developers
